title: Historical dates of the prehistory of quantum mechanics: NobelPrize.org laureate fact pages and the Crossref record of Davisson and Germer, Phys. Rev. 30, 705 (1927)
authors: Crossref (metadata registry; record deposited by the American Physical Society)

retrieval.route: fetched with curl by the Lecture 1 agent on 2026-10-20 (HTTP 200 each); the APS abstract page https://journals.aps.org/pr/abstract/10.1103/PhysRev.30.705 answered 403 and was replaced by the Crossref record of the same DOI

identity_check: each HTML page carries its own citation line 'MLA style: <Laureate> – Facts. NobelPrize.org. Nobel Prize Outreach 2026. Tue. 20 Oct 2026. <url>'; the Crossref JSON names title 'Diffraction of Electrons by a Crystal of Nickel', authors Davisson and Germer, container 'Physical Review', volume 30, page 705-740
authority_for: years of the experiments and results named in the prehistory of chapter c00 (Planck's radiation law 1900, Franck-Hertz 1914, Stern-Gerlach 1922, de Broglie 1924, Davisson-Germer 1927, Einstein's photoelectric work from 1905); the black-body and Stern-Gerlach summary sentences of the Planck and Stern pages
limitations: secondary summaries written by Nobel Prize Outreach, not the original papers (except the Crossref bibliographic record); a quote is a sentence of the raw HTML line, which also contains the surrounding paragraph markup; the pages may change after the retrieval date. Lenard's date (1899 in the script) is not established by these pages.
